name: Given Credit
description:
Given Credit (G)
Given Credit of member

name: Adjust Void Limit
description:
Adjust Void Limit (A)
Substitute amount for Given Credit

name: Current Losing
description:
Current Losing (L)
Sum winlost (without actual stake) of all LOSE tickets
Display L as negative number

name: Current Winning
description:
Current Winning (CW)
Sum winlost (without actual stake) of all WON tickets

name: Estimate Void Amount
description:
Estimated Void Amount (E)
Sum winlost (without actual stake) of all or some (abs(L) > G/A) WON tickets

name: WinLost After Void
description:
WinLost After Void (WL)
WL = L + (CW - E)
